scope: Many-to-many opportunity map, not installed integrations, partnerships, measured speedups or a fastest-library ranking. Used means research checkout, not current main dependencies.

records.job: Compare two ways of moving the same robot.
records.deliverable: Trajectory samples, model/actuator settings and a reproducible effort/tracking report.
records.next_test: Match task, duration, limits and tuned baseline; label total energy separately from torque proxies.
records.priority_reason: Start here: existing research code and a small offline boundary.
records.status: proposed integration; evidence varies by underlying asset
records.adjacent_question: Which measured energy port and actuator limits change the ranking between two otherwise matched motions?

records.deliverable: Exact certificate, versioned model/context and an accepted/rejected result.
records.next_test: Include rationalization, verification and updates; compare existing residual checks and cached solver setup.
records.priority_reason: Start here: a checker can help without replacing the solver.
records.status: proposed integration; evidence varies by underlying asset
records.adjacent_question: When can an approximate solver result be reconstructed into a strict exact bound, and when must checking remain inconclusive?

records.job: Compare motion changes without losing path and execution constraints.
records.deliverable: Trajectory adapter plus limits, replacement trace and benchmark.
records.next_test: Compare existing TOTG/Ruckig path; check collision margins, timing and buffered replacements.
records.priority_reason: Next pilot after a standalone matched trajectory example.
records.status: proposed integration; evidence varies by underlying asset
records.adjacent_question: Can a lower-effort profile preserve collision margins, duration and queued replacement commitments?

records.job: Keep continuity and commitments when targets change.
records.next_test: Preserve native position/velocity/acceleration/jerk and timing semantics; count wrapper cost.
records.priority_reason: A regression fixture may be more useful than a new planner.
records.status: proposed integration; evidence varies by underlying asset
records.adjacent_question: What extra execution contract preserves the native trajectory across repeated replacements without losing progress?

records.job: Know which frame and how-old state a command uses.
records.deliverable: Frame/time contract and recorded delayed/reordered-message replay.
records.next_test: Check clock domains, extrapolation, buffer age and coherent command use; defaults do not establish hard bounds.
records.priority_reason: Integrate after units, frames and timestamp ownership are explicit.
records.status: proposed integration; evidence varies by underlying asset
records.adjacent_question: Can versioned frame history preserve a future command and its derivative bounds through calibration changes?

records.job: Compare stopping decisions when state or braking response is uncertain.
records.deliverable: A model-specific margin/monitor with a reproducible navigation trace.
records.next_test: Compare current Collision Monitor and speed policies; measure missed obstacles, intervention, delay and availability.
records.priority_reason: Research: physical braking/error bounds remain application inputs.
records.status: proposed integration; evidence varies by underlying asset
records.adjacent_question: Can a state-dependent age limit reduce unnecessary stops while preserving a modeled stopping reserve?

records.job: Recognize ambiguous or degenerate pose estimates.
records.deliverable: Pose/candidate checks and a small exact/noisy fixture corpus.
records.next_test: Compare existing solvePnP/decomposeHomography/calibration behavior; preserve all admissible candidates and track recall.
records.priority_reason: Start with a diagnostic around an existing solver, not a replacement claim.
records.status: proposed integration; evidence varies by underlying asset
records.adjacent_question: Can a certificate retain every admissible pose while identifying exceptional families under bounded image error?

records.job: Spend less detector-pipeline time while retaining required detections.
records.deliverable: Stage profile; exact spatial filter or refresh-policy experiment if justified.
records.next_test: Pin model/head/backend; charge rebuild/transfer overhead; report recall, small objects, new-object delay and whole-pipeline latency.
records.priority_reason: GO for profiling; no measured neural-forward speedup.
records.status: proposed integration; evidence varies by underlying asset
records.adjacent_question: What uncertainty signal requires a full-frame refresh, including new objects outside every tracked region?

records.job: Connect generated controller choices to checkable model obligations.
records.deliverable: Fixed model/gain/constraint record, arithmetic assumptions and checker output.
records.next_test: Compare existing generated solver at matched precision and constraints; include infeasible and ill-conditioned cases.
records.priority_reason: A generated file is not target execution or timing proof.
records.status: proposed integration; evidence varies by underlying asset
records.adjacent_question: Can a cheap independent recovery check admit useful early-terminated solutions under bounded model mismatch?

records.job: Explain a numerical stability or margin result.
records.deliverable: Residual, conditioning and exact-obligation report for a supplied model.
records.next_test: Test stable/unstable/near-boundary models; compare existing library result and scale sensitivity.
records.priority_reason: Known control theory; useful evidence and diagnostics are the proposed product.
records.status: proposed integration; evidence varies by underlying asset
records.adjacent_question: Can one unchanged certificate interface reduce manual proof work on a genuinely different plant?

records.job: Test a scoped control or geometry result in a richer robot model.
records.deliverable: One model, task contract and matched baseline example.
records.next_test: Recheck dynamics, contacts, actuation and representation assumptions; measure violations and task completion.
records.priority_reason: Broader model support can expose why a simple theorem stops applying.
records.status: proposed integration; evidence varies by underlying asset
records.adjacent_question: Do certified bounds survive actual trajectory replacement, interpolation and scalar conversion?

records.job: Keep command history and validity visible at the robot-client boundary.
records.deliverable: A typed adapter, mock client and replacement/cancellation corpus.
records.next_test: Check buffered commitments, thread/clock semantics and rejection before hardware use.
records.priority_reason: Candidate Rust consumer after a supported Rust core exists.
records.status: proposed integration; evidence varies by underlying asset
records.adjacent_question: What cancellation and publication protocol preserves both accepted commitments and authoritative current state?

records.job: Make command checks small and inspectable in a PLC scan.
records.deliverable: Integer-scaled guard, versioned payload and signed-boundary test vectors.
records.next_test: Name compiler/runtime; test rounding, overflow, repeated scans, cold start and context changes.
records.priority_reason: No compiler-validated PLC package or safety certification yet.
records.status: proposed integration; evidence varies by underlying asset
records.adjacent_question: How does a static checked correction become a sound repeated-scan protocol with explicit rounding and update semantics?
